title: The Minimal Repro
prompt: A field incident: `lastUnique` was reported to return the wrong element. The contract: return the last value that appears exactly once (nullopt when none). Implement it correctly — the graded tests encode both the reported failure and the general contract.

tests.name: the reported case
tests.hint: Count occurrences (map or nested loop), then scan from the end for the first element whose count is 1.

tests.name: order matters across the whole range
tests.hint: Count first, then a single reverse scan — checking only neighbors (v[i] vs v[i-1]) fails these mixed patterns.
